scope: 3D visual concept exploration only. Supersedes the rejected shared hand ledger. No HTML implementation or application changes in this revision.
spatial_contract: Each hand retains one fixed lateral anchor for cards, blackjack total, scoring rows and local contribution subtotal.
Completed scoring rows remain visible while later hands score and throughout final round review until Deal.
Current cards rise and desaturate in their own lane; neighbouring card groups and scoring histories stay readable.
Score strips grow upward into the space vacated by dealer and draw tray, with a shared round tally above all three lanes.
Local cash and multiplier increments animate toward the shared counters without removing the local evidence.
Local multiplier values are additive contributions; the shared round multiplier starts at 1.0.
Final multiplication and collection occur once for the round. No invented independent per-hand payouts.
Header, six relic slots, Hand Scores, Deck and one bottom main action position retain the simplified table layout.
unresolved: Row capacity for large hands, many matching groups and relic-triggered rows needs a dedicated high-density study.
Card lift, curl, row timing and local-to-global transfer choreography require motion concepting before implementation.
The images establish adjacency and persistence, not a final production UI or measured Three.js performance.
Generated card pips, decorative relic representations and typography remain illustrative.
generation: Built-in image generation tool; original and refinement prompts saved alongside this file.
